title: Persona Profile Reinstate — payload
description: Make a retired face wearable again. It is worn nowhere afterwards: the bindings retiring cleared are not restored, because wearing a face in a context is a decision about that context, taken when it is taken.

contextId.description: The context a context-local face lives in. Omit for a pool face.

Response.title: Persona Profile Reinstate — response payload
Response.description: Success response to persona/profile/reinstate. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/persona/profile/reinstate/1.0#response. Reinstating an active face is a success that changes nothing and takes no new version.
